publication_year_note: Published 26 February 2026 in Frontiers in Sustainable Cities Vol. 8, Article 1731817 (received 24 October 2025; revised 24 December 2025; accepted 28 January 2026).
rationale: Single-community post-upgrading case study of Bamboo Settlement #3 in Trinidad and Tobago (n = 31 households) with no comparison group and no baseline data. Although the Methodology section mentions a one-sample Student's t-test confidence interval method, the Results section and Tables 1-4 report only univariate descriptive counts, percentages, means, medians, modes, and standard deviations (e.g., 31/31 with improved water, 30/31 with improved sanitation, quarterly water cost share of county-average income, room occupancy, and thematic tenure counts), with zero t-statistics, confidence intervals, p-values, or bivariate/regression tests printed anywhere in the article.
